item.title: OPINION: The pesky implications of the full picture of Alaska mining project
item.description: Win Gruening’s April 1 column asked why Juneau’s “economic naysayers” won’t connect the dots, dismissing community voices and valid concerns over the proposed easement for the New Amalga Gold Project, and going on to suggest this mining project could be the answer to all of Juneau’s economic woes, from flood mitigation to out-migration of families.
